title: 27. Spend one timeout budget

examples.explanation: The first call takes 4. The second call needs 7, but only 6 remain in the budget: `deadline`.
The call needs 8, but its own timeout is 5: `timeout`.
The call takes exactly 10 of a budget of 10. This is still a success.

hints: Compute remaining from one accumulated elapsed value.
Check response arrival before deciding whether its outcome is an error.
